question: What qualification must a previously accomplished person meet before a particular teaching is to be given to them?
premises: A particular teaching is marked as something to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Only a previously accomplished person tested for one year qualifies to receive the teaching.
uncertainties: Nature of the test not specified
plain_english: This teaching is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
